name: filament-inventory-system
description: Production-ready manual filament tracking and inventory management system for 3D printing businesses.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev:bypass: npm run use:local-bypass && npm run dev
scripts.setup:bypass: npm run use:local-bypass && npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
